results.title: Apple just revealed two ways iPhone 18 Pro could get big upgrades
results.description: Today Apple unveiled its M6 chip , the first of a new chip generation that will soon include iPhone 18 Pro’s A20 Pro. Here’s what the M6 reveals about iPhone 18 Pro gains to expect.

results.title: Waymo to launch driverless rides in Germany in 2027, entering third market outside U.S.
results.description: Waymo has been the biggest robotaxi player in the U.S., and has announced plans to enter the UK, Japan and now Germany.

results.title: PM Modi reviews Rs 30,000-crore infrastructure projects at 53rd PRAGATI meeting
results.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday chaired the 53rd meeting of PRAGATI, the ICT-enabled multi-modal platform for Pro-Active Governance and Timely Implementation, and reviewed six major infrastructure projects in the Railway, Road and Power sectors across nine states involving a cumulative investment of more than Rs 30,000 crore.
